description: Change of use from offices (Former Use class B1) to a flexible use as either offices (class E(g)) or education (Use Class F1(a)) at levels 5-8 of Volume C.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

-	Cover letter by Savills updated 22 July 2026
-	Site Location Plan Drawing Number 1EC-2026-SLP
-	1EdCity Management Strategy by EdCity Dated January 2024
-	1EdCity, White City Marketing Report Dated 16 March 2026 by Savills
-	Volume C Proposed Education Use Level 08 Drawing Number EDCITY-TPB-C0-08-DR-A-0208 Rev P01;
-	Volume C Existing/Approved Level 08 Drawing Number EDCITY-TPB-C0-08-DR-A -0608 Re P01
-	Volume C Proposed Education Use Level 07 Drawing Number EDCITY-TPB-C0-07-DR-A-0207 Rev P01
-	Volume C Existing/Approved Level 07 Drawing Number EDCITY-TPB-C0-07-DR-A-0607 Rev P01
-	Volume C Proposed Education Use Level 06 Drawing Number EDCITY-TPB-C0-06-DR-A-0206 Rev P01
-	Volume C Existing/Approved Level 06 Drawing Number EDCITY-TPB-C0-06-DR-A-0606 Rev P01
-	Volume C Proposed Education Use Level 05 Drawing Number EDCITY-TPB-C0-05-DR-A-0205 Rev P01
-	Volume C Existing/Approved Level 05 Drawing Number EDCITY-TPB-C0-05-DR-A -0605 Revision P01

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The existing provision of 172 long stay cycle parking spaces and associated showers and changing facilities shall be retained and made available for users of this development.

To promote sustainable means of transport in accordance with Policies T1, T2 and T5 of the London Plan and Policy T3 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 4 - The development shall maintain access to the existing accessible entrances, lifts, accessible toilets, refuge points and other accessibility facilities servicing levels 5-8.

To ensure that the development provides an inclusive and accessible environment in accordance with Policy D5 of the London Plan.

Condition : 5 - The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved document '1EdCity Management Strategy by EdCity Dated January 2024', unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To ensure the amenity of surrounding occupiers is not unduly affected by
noise and other disturbance, in accordance with Policies Tl , CCI 1, CC12 and CC13
of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - The existing refuse storage and servicing arrangements shall be retained and shall remain available for the approved uses.

Reason : To ensure that satisfactory provision is made for refuse and recycling facilities
and to ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding
premises are not adversely affected by noise and disturbance, in accordance with
Policies T2, CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan 2018 and SPD Key Principle TR28 (2018).

Condition : 7 - Noise from uses and activities within the building/ development site shall not exceed the criteria of BS8233:2014 at neighbouring noise sensitive rooms and private external amenity spaces. 

Reason: To protect residential amenity in accordance with Policy D14 of the London Plan and Policy CC11 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 8 - No external alterations, including installation of air-conditioning units, ventilation fans, extraction equipment, flues or other plant equipment and associated external pipework or ducting shall be fitted to the exterior of the building unless otherwise shown on the approved drawings.  

Reason: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to prevent harm to the neighbouring properties, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC2, DC4 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 9 - The floorspace hereby permitted within building Volume C, 1 EdCity Walk shall be used only as office (Use Class E(g)(i) or education use falling within Use Class F1 (a) and for no other purpose (including any other separate purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting
that Order with Or without modification).

Reason: In granting this permission, the Council has had regard to the special
circumstances of the case. Certain other uses within the same use class may
be unacceptable due to effect on residential amenity or traffic generation, in
accordance with Policies DCI, DC4, HOII, CCII, CC13 and Tl of the Local
Plan (2018).
